A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] priest''' worshiped the [[Oma-Oma]] deity and encouraged other Gungans to be worthy of his gift of life.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Gungan Priest" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Spark Lee]].
